name: Logicmelon
summary: Logicmelon's multi-posting product sends one job advert to hundreds of free and paid job boards, lets a team centralise spend and credits, and tracks where applications come from. The vendor publishes no price on its pages, only a request-a-demo option.

facts.text: The multi-posting page says a job ad can be written once and distributed to a choice of hundreds of free and paid job boards.
On Logicmelon's page, a team can handle multiple hiring locations, centralise spend, and assign access and credits to team members.
Per the page, the product offers source tracking, so a team can see where its applications come from.
No price appears on the page. Its only call to action is a request-a-demo link.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. Pricing is available on request only.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price, so no amount is recorded. Ask whether job board fees are billed on top of the platform fee, and get the answer in writing.
